newsitem.title: USA: Pacalta to up Ecuador pipe capacity.
newsitem.headline: Pacalta to up Ecuador pipe capacity.

text.p: Canada's Pacalta Resources Ltd plans to increase capacity at its Ecuador pipeline to 50,000 barrels of oil per day from the current 15,000, company president John Wright told a conference here.
"We have ordered the pipe and estimate we can start construction in two months," he said.
The company plans a C$55 million capital spend this year, of which C$21 million is for equipment and facilities.
He also expects PetroEcuador to construct new pipeline capacity.
Wriight expects the company to be producing 20,000-28,000 barrels of oil per day from its Ecuador fields by the end of 1997 and aims to compete in more bids for fields.
"We hope that the Ecuadorean government will put up some more marginal fields," he said.
